# SoraFiles

SoraFiles provides free PDF and image utilities that process supported files locally in the user's browser. Files are not uploaded to a SoraFiles processing server.

Canonical site: https://sorafiles.com/
Sitemap: https://sorafiles.com/sitemap.xml
All tools: https://sorafiles.com/tools
About: https://sorafiles.com/about
Privacy: https://sorafiles.com/privacy
Open source: https://sorafiles.com/open-source
Source repository: https://github.com/Sora-Labs2026/SoraFiles

Published tool categories include PDF compression and organization, PDF conversion, image conversion and compression, OCR, document protection, and metadata removal. Individual capabilities and limitations are stated on each tool page.

## SoraFiles Desktop

SoraFiles Desktop is a paid companion app for Windows 10+ (x64), macOS 13+ (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Ubuntu 22.04 (x64). It processes PDFs and images on the user's computer and adds file-manager actions (for example, right-click Edit with SoraFiles on Windows). The SoraFiles web tools stay free.

- Trial: seven days, starting on first launch.
- Personal (1 active device): $1.99/month, $19.99/year or $99.99 lifetime.
- Team (up to 5 active devices): $9.99/month, $99.99/year or $399.99 lifetime.
- Revoke Device frees an occupied seat for a one-time fee: Personal $0.99 (monthly/annual) or $19.99 (lifetime); Team $3.99 (monthly/annual) or $79.99 (lifetime) per occupied seat. Unused Team seats activate free.
- Prices are in USD. License activation and device changes are verified online; files are not uploaded for processing.
